items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: After Buddy left and went over to Lake, and worked regular over there on a regular job, I was taking Buddy's place on the boat with Sadie.

ctx.x: Them's only one of the bands who played bass?

There was a heavyset dog fella, but I can't think of his name. He's a chunky fat fella, but a real dog. I don't remember. I don't remember. I don't know his name. I don't know his name. He lives on Criot? He did live somewhere back. Doition was. I don't know that man's name was like. He was a barber by Trey. His name was on my tongue right there. I don't know. He'll come to you. We'll ask somebody else. We'll ask somebody else. We'll ask somebody else. I mean, I wasn't, you know, stay here long enough to get…
Trying to think of who'd be playing trombone with that band.
